title: Large cities of Latin America and the Caribbean (hot and cold)
intro: 10 large cities of Latin America and the Caribbean, one after another. You have three tries for each city and are told warmer or colder after a miss. The map shows coasts, rivers, lakes and borders, and you work inside this area.
